item.title: Ala Moana Center celebrates the Year of the Horse: Week-long activities, promotions
item.description: From Feb. 17 to Feb. 22, 2026, Ala Moana Center will ring in the Lunar New Year with a center-wide celebration honoring the Year of the Horse.

item.title: 2 killed, 3 injured in Rhode Island ice rink shooting
item.description: Three people are dead, including the suspect, and three others are in critical condition after a shooting at a Rhode Island ice skating rink Monday afternoon.

item.title: Celebrate Lunar New Year with Ten Seconds Yunnan Rice Noodle
item.description: Chinese New Year is being celebrated all month long at Ten Seconds Yunnan Rice Noodle and the restaurant is inviting the community to ring in the Lunar New Year with a festive lineup of traditional favorites and new specialty dishes.

item.title: 'A local favorite everyone loves': Malasada Day is back
item.description: Soft, chewy, delicious and usually powdered with sugar -- Feb. 17 marks the date to celebrate Malasada Day! For some, Fat Tuesday or Shrove Tuesday is the last day to indulge but in Hawaiʻi, it's part of a local tradition to enjoy malasadas.

item.title: Two men shot in Kapolei; HPD investigating attempted murders
